scripts.build: pnpm build:tally-smt-wasm && pnpm build:contract:rust && pnpm build:frontend
scripts.build:contract:rust: cd backend/contracts-rust && CLANG=clang cargo build --release --locked -p governance-contract
scripts.test:contract:vm: pnpm build:contract:rust && cargo +${HOST_RUST_TOOLCHAIN:-1.95.0} test --locked --manifest-path backend/contracts-rust/Cargo.toml -p integration-tests
scripts.check:contract:rust: cd backend/contracts-rust && CLANG=clang cargo check --locked -p governance-contract
scripts.deploy:contract: pnpm build:contract:rust && pnpm --filter ckb-voting-deploy run deploy
